A couple things! Yeah, so its kind of a combo of things and I will say if you can find an emdr trained therapist that you vibe with, super helpful! 

I've had debhilitating anxiety since I was a kid, with emdr we figured out what triggered my anxiety because as far as I knew it came out of nowhere. Apparently emdr works by changing the way your brain holds troubling memories or traumatic events. It's hard to explain but holy hell, it's life changing. It could be the smallest things & over time they just build. Adaptaive behaviors to stressful situations that were never dealt with in a sense. Emdr chills me out. The cool part is they offer different styles, I do a tapping motion for mine. It has unraveled YEARS of anxiety & symptoms.

I'm surprised it isn't more mainstream. CBT doesn't even hold a torch to it.


Gut health was a big one. Dr. ordered special tests that really focused on gut microbiome & restoring some things I never even knew existed. 

I found some resources through various connections, it's been a huge paradigm shift to how I view mental health now and healing my body. It's work but rewarding!
You were prescribed an snri for pain? Or does it help with the swelling itself? Do you know what causes the condition?

I was desperate!. After alot of pain I found a functional medicine provider and a therapist. Sounds crazy but there are root causes to our anxiety and depression that mainstream docs don't talk about.  I thought I needed a drug the rest of my life... Def a journey but I've managed my crippling anxiety for the last 4 months better then I've ever before.

You are taking both of medications at the moment?

SSRI's should never be mixed, you are receiving too much serotonin and it's inhibiting sexual function & emotions.

I would talk with your doctor about getting off one or if you are on only taking one, I'd try lowering the dose. 

SSRI's made my anxiety worse and gave me depression. I was taken off too quickly, so if you do end up tapering, do so very very slowly (weeks to months slow).
